description: Read-only. GraphQL against a DeXe subgraph: 'pools' (DAOs, proposals, voters, delegations, experts, sales), 'interactions' (per-user tx feed), 'validators'. Bound every list with `first:` (max 1000), page with `skip:`; oversized responses are rejected. Entity and field names must match the subgraph schema exactly — root fields are not entity names (DaoPool -> `daoPools`), and a wrong name errors with where to look it up. `chainId` picks the endpoint (pools: 56, validators: 56, interactions: 56; default 56); the reply echoes `indexedChainId`, never another chain's rows.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

variables.description: GraphQL variables referenced by the query
